_about: Machine-readable cell ledger for the Rosetta. Fields follow 10_CELL_AUDIT_SCHEMA_2026_04_25.md,
plus `projection_id` — the namespace fix. Bare row references like 'L7 is teleology' are ambiguous
and, as of 2026-07-31, INVERTED between packs: PHIL7 places teleology at L1 and GEN7 at L7;
PHIL7 places ontology at L6 and GEN7 at L5. Both are recorded below as data.
This file is validated by check_rosetta_cells.py. It is a SEED, not the corpus: it holds the
cells needed to make the checker meaningful. Cells are added as they are audited, not in bulk.

packs.normalization_steps: none — the source is itself a seven-question schema authored in-corpus
packs.rival_note: PHIL5 is BUILT, not pending. It carves four PHIL7 rows from one traditional branch (metaphysics) and contains one branch — aesthetics — that PHIL7 cannot express.

packs.description: Selected symbolic crosswalk: operator, varna, method, discipline, regime.
packs.normalization_steps: several source traditions have native cardinalities other than 7; see per-cell notes

rival_debt.reason: No counter-rival built. GEN7 crosswalks operator/varna/method/discipline/regime — several source traditions have native cardinalities other than 7, so a domain-native rival at its own cardinality is the honest test. Until one exists, GEN7's seven-ness is untested.

packs.description: COUNTER-RIVAL to PHIL7. The traditional five branches of philosophy: metaphysics, epistemology, logic, ethics, aesthetics. Attested for centuries, independent of this corpus, natively five.
packs.normalization_steps: none — used at its own cardinality, deliberately. Normalizing it to seven would destroy the comparison it exists to make.

cells.domain_expression: Teleology — what end or purpose is being proposed?
cells.fit_reason: Purpose is placed first because it bounds what the later questions are allowed to be about.
cells.mirror_check: unknown — L1/L7 mirror is a hypothesis, not an established relation
cells.kill_criterion: A worked case where purpose is only settleable AFTER the world-model and value questions, making L1 placement incoherent.
cells.downgrade_path: demote to interpretive, or split purpose into framing-purpose and terminal-purpose
cells.discarded_information: Teleology's classical entanglement with final causation is dropped.

cells.fit_reason: Ultimate horizon is placed last as the constitutional limit on everything below it.
cells.kill_criterion: DIRECT COLLISION WITH PHIL7__L1__Teleology, verified 2026-07-31. One term, two packs, maximally inverted rows. Killed as a BARE claim: 'L7 is teleology' is true only inside GEN7 and exactly backwards inside PHIL7. Survives only namespaced.
cells.downgrade_path: namespace-only. Never cite without the projection_id prefix.
cells.discarded_information: Whether the two packs mean the same thing by 'teleology' at all is unresolved.

cells.domain_expression: Ontology — what kinds of entities or relations are posited?
cells.fit_reason: Entity and boundary commitments are audited late, after a world model exists to populate.
cells.kill_criterion: COLLIDES WITH GEN7__L5__Ontology, verified 2026-07-31. Same term, adjacent-inverted rows.
cells.discarded_information: The distinction between ontology-as-inventory and ontology-as-being is flattened.

cells.fit_reason: Architecture and schema placed at L5 as the design layer.
cells.kill_criterion: Collides with PHIL7__L6__Ontology. Bare 'L5 is ontology' is unsafe.
cells.discarded_information: Systematic philosophy and ontology are not synonyms; the cell treats them as one.

cells.domain_expression: Metaphysics — What exists, and what is its ultimate nature?
cells.fit_reason: PHIL7 splits this ONE traditional branch across THREE rows — L5 Cosmology, L6 Ontology, L7 Theology — and additionally hoists teleology out of it into L1. Four PHIL7 rows are carved from one PHIL5 branch.
cells.mirror_check: not applicable — PHIL5 makes no mirror claim, and its silence on mirrors is itself informative
cells.kill_criterion: PHIL7 earns the split only if the four carved rows are shown to move independently. If cosmology, ontology, theology and teleology always co-vary in worked cases, PHIL5 explains the same material with one row instead of four and PHIL7's cardinality is decoration.
cells.downgrade_path: if PHIL7 demonstrates independent movement of its carved rows, demote PHIL5 to historical reference
cells.discarded_information: Sub-branch structure within each traditional branch.

cells.domain_expression: Epistemology — What can be known, and how is knowledge justified?
cells.fit_reason: Maps cleanly to PHIL7 L2. The one row where both partitions agree without remainder.
cells.mirror_check: not applicable — PHIL5 makes no mirror claim, and its silence on mirrors is itself informative
cells.kill_criterion: No kill condition — this correspondence is as close to free as the comparison gets, which is why it carries no evidential weight for the seven.
cells.downgrade_path: if PHIL7 demonstrates independent movement of its carved rows, demote PHIL5 to historical reference
cells.discarded_information: Sub-branch structure within each traditional branch.

cells.fit_reason: Maps to PHIL7 L3 Methodology, imperfectly: logic is narrower than methodology, which also carries test design and route selection.
cells.mirror_check: not applicable — PHIL5 makes no mirror claim, and its silence on mirrors is itself informative
cells.kill_criterion: If methodology's non-logical content (test design, alternatives, routing) turns out to be doing the real work, then PHIL7 L3 is not a refinement of logic but a different category wearing its name.
cells.downgrade_path: if PHIL7 demonstrates independent movement of its carved rows, demote PHIL5 to historical reference
cells.discarded_information: Sub-branch structure within each traditional branch.

cells.domain_expression: Ethics — What ought to be done, and what is good?
cells.fit_reason: Maps to PHIL7 L4 Axiology. Close, though axiology conventionally covers value theory broadly, of which ethics is one part.
cells.mirror_check: not applicable — PHIL5 makes no mirror claim, and its silence on mirrors is itself informative
cells.kill_criterion: If PHIL7 L4 is used in practice only for ethical authorization, the broader axiology label is inflation.
cells.downgrade_path: if PHIL7 demonstrates independent movement of its carved rows, demote PHIL5 to historical reference
cells.discarded_information: Sub-branch structure within each traditional branch.

cells.domain_expression: Aesthetics — What is beautiful, and how is form judged?
cells.fit_reason: NO PHIL7 ROW. The seven-question schema has no aesthetics row at all — this is a term the finer partition cannot express.
cells.mirror_check: not applicable — PHIL5 makes no mirror claim, and its silence on mirrors is itself informative
cells.kill_criterion: This is PHIL5's strongest card and it does not need a kill condition: a partition claiming to cover the philosophical field while omitting one of its five traditional branches owes an explanation. Either aesthetics is absorbed somewhere unstated, or PHIL7 is not a covering partition.
cells.downgrade_path: if PHIL7 demonstrates independent movement of its carved rows, demote PHIL5 to historical reference
cells.discarded_information: Sub-branch structure within each traditional branch.
